literal: Within the mind of the small-minded, there is not the outlook that says, 'We will cherish and adopt the great'.
translation: The attitude of wanting to cherish and align oneself with great minds does not exist within the consciousness of the small-minded.
modern: சிறிய குணம் உடையவர்களின் மனத்தில், பெரியவர்களைப் போற்றிப் பாராட்டிக் கொள்வோம் என்னும் நோக்கம் இருப்பதில்லை.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the small-minded (சிறியார்) with the truly great (பெரியார்). It states that those of low character lack the mental capacity or attitude (நோக்கு) to appreciate and cherish the great. The word 'உணர்ச்சி' refers to their inner consciousness or perception, which is too narrow to harbor the noble aspiration of seeking the company and guidance of the wise. Because of their limited vision, they never think of honoring or learning from those who are superior in character.
